question.text: A deep ITM call with strike Rs. 400 has premium Rs. 130 when stock is at Rs. 525. What percentage of the premium is intrinsic value?

explanation.text: The Logic: Step-by-step: 1. Call intrinsic value = max(S - X, 0) = max(525 - 400, 0) = Rs. 125 2. Time Value = Premium - Intrinsic Value = 130 - 125 = Rs. 5 3. Intrinsic value as a percentage of premium = 125 / 130 x 100 = 96.15%, which rounds to approximately 96.2%. The Trap: Deep ITM options have very high intrinsic value and very low time value as a percentage of the premium. Confusing time value with intrinsic value, or assuming the premium is 100% intrinsic, leads to the wrong answer. Note: The workbook (pages 64-66 and 76-78) gives long-call delta a range of 0 to +1; deep ITM calls sit toward the upper end of that range, reflecting their high intrinsic value and low time value.
